title: Pricing Methodology: The Extra-Guest Ceiling of a Roamhaven Listings Listing
content:
# Pricing Methodology — The Extra-Guest Ceiling

*Pricing team methodology for Roamhaven Listings.*

## 1. Clause

A listing's extra-guest fee may be no higher than its extra-guest ceiling, and a fee standing above that ceiling is reset to the ceiling exactly, the reset being logged as one change of the extra-guest fee; a fee at or below the ceiling is left as it stands, and the reset leaves the extra-guest threshold as it stands.

## 2. The per-guest portion

The per-guest portion of the nightly rate is the listing's nightly rate divided by its extra-guest threshold, the number of guests the nightly rate covers.

## 3. The extra-guest ceiling

The standard extra-guest share is **0.70**. The extra-guest ceiling is the per-guest portion multiplied by the extra-guest share; the share is combined in full first and applied once to the per-guest portion. The result is capped at the space type's extra-guest fee maximum and rounded half up to the cent at that final step only. The standard extra-guest ceiling — the per-guest portion multiplied by 0.70 — therefore never exceeds the space type's extra-guest fee maximum.

## 4. Inputs

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| nightly rate | the listing record |
| extra-guest threshold | the listing record |
| extra-guest fee maximum | the space type's figure for the extra-guest fee, per extra guest per night |

## 5. Worked examples (hypothetical listings, share 0.70)

| Nightly rate | Extra-guest threshold | Per-guest portion | Portion multiplied by 0.70 | Space type's extra-guest fee maximum (hypothetical) | Extra-guest ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $240.00 | 4 guests | $60.00 | $42.00 | $150.00 | $42.00 |
| $185.00 | 3 guests | $61.666… | $43.1666… | $150.00 | $43.17 |
| $900.00 | 2 guests | $450.00 | $315.00 | $300.00 | $300.00 — capped |

On the first listing, an extra-guest fee of $55.00 stands above the ceiling of $42.00 and is reset to $42.00; a fee of $40.00 is left as it stands.
